The '''Imperial Army''' was the ground forces of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It fought against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and the [[Galactic War]].

They were involved in the [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|Battle of Bothawui]] where they faced a devastating defeat against the Republic defenders. The Imperial Army was also involved in the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] which brought about the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] that left both the Empire and the Republic in a state of cold war.

==History==
[[File:Imperial_Commandos_on_Makeb.png|left|thumb|[[Imperial commando (Sith Empire)|Imperial Commandos]] on [[Makeb]]]]
After fleeing [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the remainder of the Sith Empire stumbled on the jungle world of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], after drifting in space for years. Once there, the first [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] began a program to make a new Imperial military. He drafted all non-Sith of age into the army and established a training regimen that would still be used thirteen centuries later.

Over the years, they carved into the jungles of Dromund Kaas, fighting off its hostile beasts to make room for the Empire's new capital city. After the Imperial armada was completed, the [[Army/Legends|Army]] and [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] were eventually deployed, in what is thought to be the greatest strategic invasion in galactic history, against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] opening the [[Great Galactic War]].

A notable failure of the Army engagement was the Sith Empire's second attempt at taking [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], where despite vast numbers, greater than the opposition, they failed thanks to the poor strategy of throwing their numbers at the enemy.

Since the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] their engagements were reduced to peace keeping, as the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] forbids Imperial and Republic engagements, despite this they remained in active duty, still deployed against the Republic in disputed territory.

By the time of the Cold War, the Army could be found in large numbers across [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]]. Some of the troopers stationed on Korriban were corrupted by the planet's dark energies and went psychotic, attacking their own comrades.

==Organization==
[[File:Balmorra_Imperial_Sentinel.png|thumb|[[Imperial soldier|Sith Trooper]] of the Imperial Army stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].]]
The Imperial Army was the ground forces of the Sith Empire, and the [[Imperial soldier|soldiers]] of the Empire typically wore gray armor but sometimes also wore black, white, green and red armor (black and white being used by commandos, green by the Grenadiers) and carried [[TH-17 blaster rifle|TH-17]] or [[DLA-13 heavy blaster rifle|DLA-13]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] into combat. Ground forces begin live-fire exercises in the jungles of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] within weeks of their enlistment into the military, and even those non-combatants in the military were trained in the use of basic weapons, survival skills, and first aid. The Army also made use of [[Imperial crawler tank]]s, walkers, and a number of models of war droids. Imperial heavy troopers were issued full-body gray armor crafted from [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]], with colored markings signifying their unit or special assignments. Their leg armor was specially designed to preserve mobility and to protect from shrapnel, and while their belt housed extra ammunition and grenades for easy access, the armor's bracers housed environmental and targeting controls, and the readouts on the suit's chest provided medical diagnostics for treating soldiers who were wounded in their armor. Heavy infantry soldiers typically wore about a hundred pounds of armor, and most soldiers carried rifles, sidearms, grenades, and five days of rations. The typical service period for an Imperial soldier was twenty-five to thirty years.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Imperial Army rank structure was as follows: [[Private/Legends|Private]], [[Specialist/Legends|Specialist]], [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]], [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], [[Major/Legends|Major]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]], and finally [[General/Legends|General]].

The Imperial Army was divided into various subgroups, including:
*'''Fire team: '''consisted of two or three soldiers, led by a corporal.
*'''Squad:''' ranged from five to ten soldiers, led by a sergeant.
*'''Platoon:''' ranged from 50 to a 100 soldiers, commanded by lieutenant.
*'''Company:''' ranged from 100 to 300 soldiers, led by a captain.
*'''Battalion: '''ranged from 700 to 1,500 soldiers, commanded by a major.
*'''Brigade: '''ranged from 5,000 to 7,500 soldiers, led by a colonel.
*'''Division: '''ranged from 20,000 to 40,000 soldiers, commanded by a general.
*A larger unit designated an "Assault Group" or "[[Operations Group]]" could be formed from over 40,000 soldiers, which were placed under the command of a Moff or high-ranking Sith Lord for specific assignments and then broken up after the completion of the mission.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
